items.title: A flat finitely presented quasi-finite separated map induces a canonical closed stratification of the base by finite locally free degree with quasi-compact strata
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For f : X -> S flat, locally of finite presentation, separated and quasi-finite, the lemma builds closed subsets Z_{-1} empty contained in Z_0 contained in Z_1 ... in S such that S_r = Z_r minus Z_{r-1} is the locus where the projection X x_S T -> T is finite locally free of degree r exactly when the map factors set-theoretically through S_r, and moreover each inclusion S_r -> S is quasi-compact. The retained proof is written in two paragraphs: existence uses universal boundedness of the fibres (Morphisms, lemma-locally-quasi-finite-qc-source-universally-bounded) feeding the chapter's bounded-degree stratification lemma; quasi-compactness of the strata is shown by proving each difference U_r -> U_{r-1} quasi-compact through a descent argument where the ideal of the closed stratum is cut down to a finitely generated ideal via Limits, lemma-descend-finite-locally-free, making the complement a finite union of standard opens. Retained author proof at lines 12861-12889.
